description: Test suite for FrameMapper functionality, including trace association across multiple trace types such as ProtoLog, WindowManager, IME, Transactions, SurfaceFlinger, and ScreenRecording.

classes.name: TraceBuilder
classes.description: Utility class for building trace objects with entries, timestamps, and frame associations.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Represents a trace of a specific type, holding entries and timestamps.

classes.name: Traces
classes.description: Container for multiple Trace objects, managing different trace types.

classes.name: FrameMapper
classes.description: Main class under test, responsible for computing frame mappings across different trace types.

classes.name: RealTimestamp
classes.description: Represents a high-precision timestamp used in trace entries.

classes.name: LayerTraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a layer trace entry in SurfaceFlinger.

classes.name: WindowManagerState
classes.description: Represents the state of the window manager at a given timestamp.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Represents a log message in proto logs.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingTraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a screen recording trace entry.

classes.name: TraceType
classes.description: Enumeration of different trace types such as PROTO_LOG, WINDOW_MANAGER, IME, TRANSACTIONS, SURFACE_FLINGER, SCREEN_RECORDING.

methods.name: computeMapping
methods.description: Method of FrameMapper that computes the frame-to-trace association.
